text:
Hello, hello, Wedgehurst!
Your Champion, Leon, is back!\c
I promise I’ll keep doing my best to deliver the
greatest battles for you all to watch![VAR 0114(0004)]
It’s our unbeatable Champion!\nLeon, you and Charizard are the greatest!

Well, thank you for that!\c
I hope you’ll all carry on training up your
Pokémon and never shy from battle.\c
Then come challenge me for the Champion title![VAR 0114(0004)]
We’re on it! We’ve all been working on our battle\nskills just like you’ve taught us to, Lee!
But that Charizard of yours is too strong for\nthe likes of us to take on!

Too true that Charizard is blazingly strong.
But other Pokémon can be strong as well!\c
That’s why I want the strongest of challengers
to fill the Gym Challenge and come battle me![VAR 0114(0004)]
My wish is for Galar’s Trainers to work together\nto become the strongest in all the world![VAR 0114(0004)]
So, my number-one fan in all the world has come\nout of his way to pick me up![VAR 0114(0004)]
Look at you, Hop!\c\nI reckon you’ve grown...exactly an inch and a\nquarter since the last time I saw you![VAR 0114(0004)]
Bingo! That’s the sort of sharp eye that’s kept\nyou undefeated so long, eh, Lee?[VAR 0114(0005)]

And these bright eyes over here...\c
I’ve got it!
You must be [VAR 0100(0000)]—am I right?
I’ve heard loads about you from my little brother.[VAR 0114(0004)]
I’m the Galar region’s greatest-ever Pokémon\nChampion—and a massive Charizard fan, too.\c\nPeople call me the unbeatable Leon![VAR 0114(0004)]
Come on, Lee! And you, [VAR 0100(0000)]!\nBet I can beat the both of you back home![VAR 0114(0005)]

That Hop...
Always wanting to be the best, isn’t he?\c
With a proper rival of his own, I bet he’d push
himself to become something truly special...[VAR 0114(0004)]

Well, everyone! I bid you farewell for today!
But don’t you fret...\c
I’ll always be around to make sure everyone in
Galar can have a champion time![VAR 0114(0004)]
